This update is notable for adding the [[Frost Champion]]. This update encompassed seven versions: the main v2.8.0 update (released 28 August 2026) and six minor updates, the v2.8.0a (released 28 August 2026), v2.8.1 (released 28 August 2026), v2.8.1a (released 29 August 2026), v2.8.2 (released 29 August 2026) and v2.8.3 (released 31 August 2026). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *[[Frost Champion]] ===Miscellaneous=== *Preview button in skins menu.
